name: Ogeretsu Daihyakka
source:
Main character is a researcher. He finds drawings of a robot in the rubble of a collapsed wall of the mansion. He manages to attract an investor for robot creation project, and now he needs to send progress reports at regular time intervals. But cute robot girl is worth it.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名研究员。他在宅邸倒塌墙壁的瓦砾中，发现了机器人的设计图。他设法为机器人制造计划吸引到投资者，如今需要定期提交进度报告。不过，可爱的机器人女孩值得这一切。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-november-2002-baldr-force.html]vndbreview[/url]]
